— Under the canopy —
Fallen trunks lie like sleeping animals, furred with moss. The ground gives underfoot — centuries of leaf-mold.
The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Christian blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
